name: SV07 pre-print checklist (MTS shop)
items: Go-ahead given for THIS print, and the support scope if it has supports
Filament bend test done (dry 45 C 4-6 h or swap if it snaps); spool noted
Heated 220 / 65, soaked 5 min, Z_TILT_ADJUST hot, BED_MESH_PROFILE LOAD=default, no SAVE_CONFIG after
Sliced from v3 (or a named copy of it); G-code header checked (see the automatic check)
Uploaded with print=false and the file read back on the printer
First layer checked by telemetry and in person (camera frames are not proof)
Tall part: watching closely between 60 and 75 min
